title: [Aegis AI] Secure Desktop AI Assistant, Open Source, 90+ Providers, Computer Automation
author: hieulouisdev
selftext:
Hi everyone! After 10+ weeks of development, we're launching Axiom (Aegis AI) — a privacy-first AI desktop assistant written in Rust + React.

The problem we solved:  
\- Most AI assistants upload your data to the cloud  
\- They can't automate your computer  
\- They forget everything between sessions  
\- You're locked into one provider's models

What we built:  
\- 90+ AI providers in one app (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, DeepSeek, Ollama, etc.) — switch with 1 click  
\- Computer automation: AI can open apps, read/write files, run shell commands, automate GUI  
\- Persistent memory: AI remembers things about you via vector-embedding RAG  
\- Military-grade security: 3 layers of protection, auto-defense monitor, hard-deny list  
\- 100% privacy: SQLite database stays on your device, no telemetry, no cloud sync

Tech stack:  
\- Backend: Rust 1.97.1 + Tauri 2.0  
\- Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind  
\- Database: SQLite (embedded)

**Current version:** v0.5 (Phase 3.3)  
\- Voice I/O (push-to-talk transcription + TTS)  
\- CalDAV calendar integration  
\- Bilingual UI (English & Vietnamese)

**Platforms:** Linux & Windows (macOS coming Phase 4)

**License:** MIT (completely free and open source)

We'd love feedback, bug reports, and contributions. Feel free to ask questions!
